$comment: Terminal state of every parity-backed module. The gate
config/scripts/check-cutover-census.mjs re-checks these CLAIMS against the tree; it does
not infer them. A module with no entry fails the gate, which is the point — the list
cannot rot by someone adding a module and forgetting to decide about it.
states: crossed = TS no longer implements it | retained = a TS impl stays, for the stated
reason | never = deliberately held out of the shipped artifacts.
A `check` script must exit 0 while its reason still holds and non-zero once the blocker
clears, so a refusal expires instead of going stale.

agent-recognition.reason: Faithful and affordable per call, but the callers answer one question with a 10-12 call ladder. Port the classifier and cross that once.

agent-scratch-worktrees.reason: agent-scratch-repo-roots.ts; the legacy* matchers are its fallback bodies

agent-status-types.reason: agent-status-evaluation.ts; the twin import is types.ts

browser-screencast-protocol.reason: Screencast frame decode: per-VIDEO-FRAME, and imported by mobile/src/transport/, which never installs a binding — the fallback would be permanent.

browser-search.reason: looksLikeSearchQuery IS crossed. buildSearchUrl is not: the core takes no options and would drop the Kagi private-session token.

cross-platform-path.reason: isWindowsAbsolutePathLike is called from inside three shims pre-ready fallbacks. A fallback that dispatches is not a fallback.

feature-tips.reason: feature-tip-selection.ts; FEATURE_TIPS stays as its fallback table

fleet-exceptions.reason: git-wasm/fleet-exception-queue.ts; the twin import is a data const

fleet-identity.reason: Zero production consumers: nothing outside src/shared/fleet-identity/ and its own tests imports the directory. Built ahead of R1 (§8), the next unbuilt phase.

keep-tail.reason: Hot path: update() runs on every pending-data change.

mcp-env.reason: maskMcpEnv and mcp-config.ts inspectMcpConfigContent are LIVE — McpConfigSection.tsx and settings/mcp-config-inspection.ts import them at HEAD. An earlier claim that they were dead read the working tree, where another session has an uncommitted mcp cutover.

mcp.reason: A cutover to renderer/lib/git-wasm/mcp-config-content-inspection.ts is IN FLIGHT as another session uncommitted work — the shim is untracked. At HEAD the TS twin is still the live path (McpConfigSection.tsx, settings/mcp-config-inspection.ts). Re-triage when that lands.

mobile-relay-pairing-offer.reason: createPairingOfferSchema is a zod schema factory: it returns a validator, not a value. Not a crossable shape.

nacl-box.reason: Parity-only oracle. Held out so curve25519 does not bloat the relay wasm.

orchestration-store.reason: Parity-only oracle. Held out so rusqlite does not bloat the relay wasm.

policy.reason: decideFleetGrant IS wired. decidePlayPath and isAllowedPlayHost are referenced only by play-path-guard.ts itself — the play server they guard is not built yet.

quick-open-filter.reason: buildExcludePathPrefixes is not a pure function of its arguments — node:path.relative() resolves both operands against process.cwd(). The other three are per-file over an unbounded scan.

skill-metadata.reason: main/skills/rust-skill-metadata.ts; the shared TS parser is deleted

terminal-stream-protocol.reason: Terminal binary framing: per-FRAME on the hottest stream in the app, and imported by mobile/src/transport/, which never installs a binding — the fallback would be permanent.

uri-component.reason: Mirrors the JS globals encodeURIComponent/decodeURIComponent. There is no dedicated TS file to cut over.

worktree-id.reason: A cutover to src/shared/worktree-id-parsing.ts is IN FLIGHT as another session uncommitted work — the shim is untracked. At HEAD all 63 callers still import the twin. The core is correct and 37 vectors pin it, so this lands cheaply once that session resolves.

worktree-ownership.reason: orca-workspace-layouts.ts + worktree-ownership-policy.ts; twin import is types.ts
